name: OPEN-TEST address-book HTTPS issuer chain
scope: Only sdk_addressbook.php fixed https://open-test.digg.se upstream host
purpose: Provide the two missing issuer certificates from the server TLS chain while retaining peer, hostname and validity verification. This bundle is a complete public CA chain, not a leaf-certificate pin and not an SDK/O2O message certificate.

certificates.subject: C = FI, O = Telia Finland Oyj, CN = Telia Root CA v2
certificates.issuer: C = FI, O = Telia Finland Oyj, CN = Telia Root CA v2

certificates.subject: C = SE, O = Telia Company AB, CN = Telia RSA TLS Root CA v3
certificates.issuer: C = FI, O = Telia Finland Oyj, CN = Telia Root CA v2

certificates.subject: C = SE, O = Telia Company AB, CN = Telia RSA OV CA v4
certificates.issuer: C = SE, O = Telia Company AB, CN = Telia RSA TLS Root CA v3

root_provenance.source: Mozilla CA root store distributed by certifi
root_provenance.verification: OpenSSL verified current server leaf and both issuer signatures to the existing Mozilla-trusted root, with sslserver purpose and open-test.digg.se hostname. Root certificate from Telia matched the existing root byte for byte in DER format.

maintenance: If the upstream CA hierarchy changes, obtain replacements from the authoritative CA and validate to a trusted root before refreshing this scoped bundle. Do not disable TLS verification.
